title: Requirements Analysis Schema
description: Schema for validating AI-generated requirements analysis output

businessRules.description: List of explicit and implicit business rules

actors.description: List of actors/users involved in the user story

preconditions.description: Conditions that must exist before the user story execution

postconditions.description: Conditions that must exist after the user story execution

gaps.description: Missing information that should be defined in requirements

ambiguities.description: Behaviors not specified clearly in requirements
